art_direction: 一盘无字磁带以青色边光和粉色卷轴简化呈现，深紫背景上带一圈细轨道。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a compact retro cassette reduced to a charcoal rectangle with two magenta reel circles and a thin cyan illuminated edge. Its surface is blank, with no label, writing, or logos. Tilt the cassette slightly and place a single fine elliptical light line behind it, suggesting motion without becoming a planet illustration. Use a solid dark violet ground and one small hard-edged shadow beneath the object. Keep the reel geometry visible and the casing corners gently rounded. Limit reflections to one narrow pale highlight. The image should combine a recognizable everyday object with a restrained electronic color palette, staying bold and readable at small avatar size.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
